[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Half-Caf, Half-Decaf: Mix half regular coffee with half decaf coffee beans.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Coffee with Ginseng and Honey: Add ginseng powder and honey to coffee.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Low-Caffeine Coffee Blends: Use Arabica or Liberica beans or blends labeled as "low-caffeine."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Coffee with Oat Milk and Cinnamon: Combine coffee with oat milk and cinnamon.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Yerba Mate Latte: Use yerba mate as a low-caffeine alternative.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Coffee with Coconut Water and Lime: Add coconut water and lime juice to coffee.  
[USER] User expressed interest in the cascara latte and requested a simple recipe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a simple recipe for Cascara Latte with ingredients and instructions:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients: 1 teaspoon of cascara powder or 2-3 whole dried cascara cherries, 1 cup of hot water, 3-4 oz of milk, optional sweeteners and spices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions: Steep cascara, strain, prepare milk, combine, and top with foam.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips and variations for the cascara latte were also provided.
